control.text: Off the line and still walking away: abort before she passes the limit. She will not come back on her own.

lox.text: Engine out early, she falls short: a solid radar track is your best point.

thrust.text: Hot and fast and dry early, she goes long: a solid radar track is your best point.

radar.text: Dropouts on the radar plot: give Recovery the computer's point, not the radar's.

shortburn.text: Short cutoff: check her speed against what orbit needs, less the angle. If it will not hold, NO-GO while the ships can still reach her.

seastate.text: Sea above state 4: NO-GO, however good the rest of the board looks.

offstation.text: A ship off station under a landing point: NO-GO until it is back.

seg51loose.text: Segment 51 lit: you cannot tell a loose shield from a bad switch. Keep the pack on: it costs little, a shield costs everything.

seg51false.text: Segment 51 lit: you cannot tell a loose shield from a bad switch. Keep the pack on: it costs little, a shield costs everything.

plug.text: Shut down on the pad with the escape tower gone: nobody goes near her until the batteries are flat and the oxygen has boiled off.

shutdown.text: Lit and shut down on the pad: no fire, no motion, the crew sits tight. Ejection seats are for a vehicle that is coming apart.

scanner.text: Attitude wandering and fuel burning on automatic: have him fire by hand, lined up on the horizon.
